display_long_description:
Immerse yourself in a virtual reality experience that allows you to explore different places and iconic buildings in the city of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria through 360° panoramic photographs. From a three-dimensional map, you can fly over the area, locate points of interest, and freely access the interior of each space. 
Each marker on the map opens the door to an immersive visit that allows you to observe interiors and exteriors in detail, offering a realistic and enveloping sense of presence. Navigation of the map is intuitive and completely free. 
This experience is designed to help you discover the cultural and heritage sites of the city of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria in a visual and accessible way, ideal both for those who want to see them for the first time and for those who want to rediscover them from a new perspective. Thanks to the combination of aerial exploration and 360° panoramic views, the application offers an innovative and attractive way to visit these places without physical limitations, directly from virtual reality.
